title: Cell Voltage Safety Goal

revision_history.author: safety_engineer
revision_history.description: Synthetic safety goal for hypothetical automotive BMS project

revision_history.author: safety_engineer
revision_history.description: Corrected timing_budget.allocation.margin_ms from 20 to 15 so that the recorded budget closes. The ten serial elements of the allocation sum to 85 ms (25+5+2+3+5+2+3+5+30+5) and the fault tolerant time interval is 100 ms, so the margin available is 100-85 = 15 ms; the recorded 20 ms exceeded the time that was available and made the budget total 105 ms against a 100 ms interval. A margin is a derived quantity - the difference between the interval and the work - not a measured one, so 15 ms is the only value the interval admits. Remediation of finding FB2-REV-FND-000025. The two alternative repairs were considered and rejected on the corpus's own evidence: raising the FTTI to 105 ms would contradict FB2-PRM-000004, which fixes ftti_ms = 100 with tolerance min = max = 100 and calibration by safety analysis against the HARA, and would define the interval from the answer; shrinking the serial sum to 80 ms would delete work that traces to a parameter or an assumption. The 85 ms serial figure is unchanged and is the figure FB2-SAF-TSC-000001 already recomputed independently. 15 ms is also the margin the technical safety concept already published, so this change removes the departure between the two records rather than creating one. The 105 ms total was NOT rounded down to 100 ms: the arithmetic now closes because 85 + 15 = 100, not because a number was adjusted to look equal. The FTTI value, all ten serial allocations, the statement, the safe state, the degraded state and the ASIL are unchanged.

statement: The BMS shall detect cell voltage limit violations and open all HV contactors within the fault tolerant time interval (FTTI = 100 ms) to prevent cell overvoltage/undervoltage hazardous events, with a target diagnostic test interval of 10 ms, a target contactor mechanical opening time of 30 ms (FB2-PRM-000005 / FB2-ASM-006) and a resulting 40 ms from the fault request to feedback-confirmed contactor open (FB2-SAF-FSR-000003).
safe_state: All HV contactors open, charging disabled, propulsion disabled, fault logged
degraded_state: Derated charging (0.1C), reduced discharge (0.5C), enhanced monitoring (1 Hz)
